data.long_meaning: The name Gourab is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'one who brings delight, pleasure or joy'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Gourab is associated with Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation. The name Gourab carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gourab usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
